def transform(g):
 import numpy as np
 out=[r[:] for r in g]; h=len(g); w=len(g[0])
 for c in range(w):
  seeds=[(r,g[r][c]) for r in range(h) if g[r][c]]
  if not any(r==h-1 and v==5 for r,v in seeds): continue
  for r in range(h):
   nearest=min(seeds,key=lambda x:(abs(x[0]-r),x[0]))
   out[r][c]=nearest[1]
 return out
out=transform(grid)
print('\n'.join(' '.join(map(str,r)) for r in out))
